shortDescription: Executes a SQL DQL(Data Query Language) statement.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: database
options.description: Specified database name, usually, it is the iasp name, use WRKRDBDIRE to check Relational Database Directory Entries. Default to use the C(*LOCAL) entry.

options.name: expected_row_count
options.description: The expected row count. If it is equal or greater than 0, check if the actual row count returned from the query statement is matched with the expected row count. If it is less than 0, do not check if the actual row count returned from the query statement is matched with the expected row count.

options.name: hex_columns
options.description: Specifies the column names which actually a hex string.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the job log even success.

options.name: sql
options.description: The C(ibmi_sql_query) module takes a IBM i SQL DQL(Data Query Language) statement to run.
